# Alwin Madhu — Full site index

This file is a compact, machine-readable corpus index for the portfolio of Alwin Madhu (Jeen). The canonical source for each page is linked below; the visible HTML and JSON-LD on those pages are authoritative.

## About

Alwin Madhu is a developer and researcher from Kerala, India, also known as Jeen for creative and photography work. He is pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications at Manipal University Jaipur after a Diploma in Computer Engineering and an Electronics Science background. His focus areas include computational drug discovery, bioinformatics, peer-to-peer networking, Bluetooth Low Energy, local/on-device AI, and health technology.
